input: The transport buttons a layout lists (label, catalog action), the place the board gives it and the form's theme.
output: The buttons and, always, the monitor's Auto | On switch with the one that is on (qnc-monitor); a click is the catalog action, carried out by qnc-source-panel.
specification: User 2026-10-19: a panel is the smallest unit a layout places; the monitor and its transport are separate panels so a layout may arrange them freely.
